How to use

Drag (or swipe) to look around, scroll / pinch to zoom.
Walk: click a white ring on the floor, a button at the top, or a dot on the floor plan.
Info: hover or tap the green i points for the appliances and finishes.
Photos: the full-size photoreal stills, including the two corner pull-outs opened.
Rendered in Blender Cycles from the fitter-pack dimensions (room 5540 x 2780, ceiling 2210). The drawings govern.
